Anna Hertel (born 27 October 2000) is a Polish tennis player. Hertel has a career-high WTA ranking of 542 in singles, achieved on 25 August 2025. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 285, achieved on 2 August 2021. [ 1 ] Hertel made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2021 WTA Poland Open in the doubles competition. She plays college tennis at the University of Georgia .
